summary: Assess AI use cases, check data readiness and interpret model metrics in a five-day foundation course. Explore the outline and plan your training.
lede: Artificial intelligence and machine learning training helps business and technical teams assess use cases and review model outputs. For foundation-level professionals working without a programming requirement, it covers framing business problems with CRISP-DM, checking data readiness, and interpreting model metrics and risks to support grounded next-step decisions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who assess, commission, oversee or use AI and machine learning outputs in operational workflows. It is designed for roles that need to turn a business question into a reviewable use case without requiring programming.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Bring basic familiarity with a work process or business problem you may want to assess for AI or machine learning. No programming or prior machine learning experience is required; exercises focus on use-case framing, sample data and Excel calculations.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
